{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Define the population: completed orders, excluding QA and refunded
population = sales[
    (sales['status'] == 'completed') & 
    (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)
]

# Cross-tabulate customer_segment and channel to check for confounding
confounding_check = pd.crosstab(population['customer_segment'], population['channel'])
print("Cross-tabulation of customer_segment by channel:")
print(confounding_check)

# Check proportions
segment_channel_prop = population.groupby('customer_segment')['channel'].value_counts(normalize=True).unstack(fill_value=0)
print("\nProportion of each channel within each segment:")
print(segment_channel_prop)"}
